% Markup for the diffs that release.yml makes, passed to latexdiff with
% --preamble in place of its default markup. Added text is blue, deleted text
% is red and struck through, and a table cell that is a single number is set
% with \num.
\RequirePackage[normalem]{ulem}
\providecommand{\DIFadd}[1]{{\protect\color{blue}#1}}
\providecommand{\DIFdel}[1]{{\protect\color{red}\sout{#1}}}
\providecommand{\DIFaddbegin}{}
\providecommand{\DIFaddend}{}
\providecommand{\DIFdelbegin}{}
\providecommand{\DIFdelend}{}
\providecommand{\DIFmodbegin}{}
\providecommand{\DIFmodend}{}
\providecommand{\DIFaddbeginFL}{}
\providecommand{\DIFaddendFL}{}
\providecommand{\DIFdelbeginFL}{}
\providecommand{\DIFdelendFL}{}
\providecommand*{\DIFcmidrule}[1]{\cmidrule#1}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\tl_new:N \l__diff_tl
\regex_const:Nn \c__diff_number_regex
  { \A (\s*) ([+\-]? (?: \d+ (?: \. \d* )? | \. \d+ ) (?: [eE] [+\-]? \d+ )?) (\s*) \Z }
\cs_new_protected:Npn \__diff_mark:Nn #1#2
  {
    \tl_set:Nn \l__diff_tl {#2}
    \regex_replace_once:NnN \c__diff_number_regex
      { \1 \c{num} \cB\{ \2 \cE\} \3 } \l__diff_tl
    \exp_args:NV #1 \l__diff_tl
  }
\cs_new_protected:Npn \DIFaddFL #1 { \__diff_mark:Nn \DIFadd {#1} }
\cs_new_protected:Npn \DIFdelFL #1 { \__diff_mark:Nn \DIFdel {#1} }
\ExplSyntaxOff
